name: printer-status
title: Xerox
description: Raycast extension to check Xerox printer status via SNMP
author: davidyannick

commands.name: xerox
commands.title: Xerox Printer Status
commands.description: Show the current page count of the Xerox printer

tools.name: ask-xerox
tools.title: Ask Xerox
tools.description: Retrieve current status, ink levels, page counts, and device information from the Xerox printer

preferences.name: printerIp
preferences.title: Printer IP Address
preferences.description: The IP address of your Xerox printer

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
